subject: general
question: 3 solid hemispheres of radius 2 unit each are melted and recast into a single sphere. Find the radius (in given units) of the newly cast single sphere.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of each hemisphere (r) = 2 units

Number of hemispheres = 3

**Formula used:**

Volume of a sphere = (4)/(3)pi r³ 

Volume of a hemisphere = (1)/(2)times(4)/(3)pi r³ = (2)/(3)pi r³ 

Volume of the new sphere = Total volume of the 3 hemispheres

Radius of the new sphere (R): (4)/(3)pi R³ = 3 times (2)/(3)pi r³ 

**Calculation:**

(4)/(3)pi R³ = 3 times (2)/(3)pi (2)³ 

⇒ (4)/(3)pi R³ = 3 times (2)/(3)pi times 8 

⇒ (4)/(3)pi R³ = 16pi 

⇒ (4)/(3)R³ = 16 

⇒ (R³)/(3) = 4 

⇒ R³ = 12 

⇒ R = sqrt[3]{12} 

**∴ The correct answer is option 4 (R = sqrt[3]{12} ).**
